workarounds.symptom: [PYSEC-2026-215] Internationalized Domain Names in Applications (IDNA) for Python provides support for Internationalized Domain Names in Applications (IDNA) and Unicode IDNA ... (Affects idna < 3.15)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade idna to patched release >= 3.15: pip install --upgrade 'idna>=3.15' (Advisory: PYSEC-2026-215)
